title: TaskActionRequest
description: Body of `POST /v1/tasks/{id}/actions/{action}`, optional. Each field belongs to one action.

due.description: `accept` only, optional: new due date. `Some(None)` (`null`) removes it.

importance.description: `accept` only, optional: new importance. If omitted when kind changes, resets to the new kind's default; if omitted when kind is unchanged, keeps existing importance.

kind.description: `accept` only, optional: new kind. If changed without importance, resets importance to the kind's default.

on.description: `waiting` only: what or whom the task waits on.

until.description: `waiting` only: the priority list does not show the task until this date.

Kind.description: Serialized form of `Kind`: `kind`, plus `format` for content.

format.description: Content only: talk, article, training or workshop.

kind.description:
story, bug, chore, research, investigation, review, support, content, admin, interview
or learning. Any other name makes the task read-only.
